name: Ghost
summary: Publishing platform for newsletters and memberships.

flows.title: Add a card to a post in the editor
steps: Open the post you want to edit in the Ghost editor.
Insert a card by clicking the + button, or by typing / on a new line to search for a particular card.
Choose the card you want: images, HTML, embeds, bookmarks, email-only content, and more.
Use the contextual toolbar to format your text, and to add links, quotes or headings.
Add an emoji by pressing : and continuing to type.

flows.title: Set your publication's title, description, timezone and language
steps: Set a publication title and description from the Settings, then General, then Title & description area.
Set the timezone of your publication from the Settings, then General, then Timezone area. A custom timezone is used for scheduling and publishing posts.
Set a custom language for your publication from the Settings, then General, then Publication language area, so search engines are told what language your content is in.
In the Settings, then General, then Meta data area, add custom meta data content for search engines.
